name: Caltech Winter Open 2014

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Second floor of Winnett Lounge - see website for more details

information: The cost of registration is $2n + 4, where n is the number of events, if registered before 2/15; otherwise, on-site registration is doubled. $1 will go to the WCA.  Caltech students are free.  See website for more information, particularly about events.
